mechanism.binding_level: StaticMeshComponent override (SetMaterial), NOT the StaticMesh asset's StaticMaterials array
mechanism.selector: AssetName.Contains(SSTags::...) against the asset name string
mechanism.note: SetMaterial(i, ...) on the component writes an override; the mesh asset's own StaticMaterials are left as imported.

MAT_N_M_can_be_selected_by_this_mechanis: NO. No SSTag substring appears in any MAT_N_M name, and no SetMaterial call in PrepareAssetsForCookingCommandlet references a MAT_ path.
DYNAMIC_MATERIAL_LOOKUP_basis: No LoadObject/StaticLoadObject/FindObject/FSoftObjectPath lookup keyed on a MAT_ name exists in the tile pipeline. The only runtime material binding for map meshes is the PrepareAssets SetMaterial branch above, which selects 7 fixed /Game/Carla/... material instances by asset-name tag.
